items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: Peter Bokai. That's all it's gonna do. He didn't drink, I don't think.

ctx.x: Kid Thomas, I've never seen him take a drink. I don't think he drank. No, he didn't drink? Well, I don't know. I never was around him, you see. I've never seen him drink.

Well, he ain't gonna do nothing. It won't do nothing but shock, but shock in a person's career. Peter Bokai. That's all it's gonna do. He didn't drink, I don't think. It is shock in your career. Yes, he did. It's detrimental. It's very detrimental. You don't know.

Chris Kelly. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Buddy Manaday, Joe Watson, Yang Johnson. And old Kid Punch. All them old fellas. Sam Bowman. And just drink with the song. Guy A. Butler rap is his name. But Punch doesn't drink anymore. He can.
